newsitem.title: USA: Home Insurance under supervision in N.H..
newsitem.headline: Home Insurance under supervision in N.H..

text.p: Home Holding Inc on Tuesday said the New Hampshire Insurance Department placed its principal subsidiary, Home Insurance Co, under formal supervision.
The department will oversee a review of Home Insurance's books, records and affairs "so as to determine what future actions would be appropriate," Home Holding said.

The move will have little effect on an agreement under which Risk Enterprise Management Ltd provides claims and administrative staffing needed to carry out an orderly run-off of Home Insurance's property/casualty business, it said. Only minor modifications in the services agreement are required to comply with the order.
Home Insurance ceased writing new business in June 1995. Since then, the department has actively monitored the business.
